bullets:
Architected and developed a production cinema booking platform using Next.js, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL,
supporting 10,000+ monthly users with real-time seat availability updates through WebSockets.

Designed and implemented RESTful APIs for authentication, seat allocation, payments, and booking workflows,
integrating Stripe and supporting 1,000+ daily transactions.

Optimized PostgreSQL queries using SQLAlchemy and introduced Redis caching, reducing API response times
by 25% and improving performance across high-traffic application workflows.

Designed containerized services with Docker and deployed applications on AWS EC2, implementing automated
build, test, and deployment workflows with GitHub Actions CI/CD.

Owned features from technical design through implementation, testing, code review, and production deployment;
delivered 15+ features, participated in 130+ code reviews, and mentored 3 junior developers.
